disclaimer: Artefacts seen on published 4th-edition Companion lists. Confirm text and points in Companion.

artefacts.name: Blade of Slashing
artefacts.text: Whenever the unit rolls to hit in Combat, it can re-roll one of the dice that failed to hit.

artefacts.name: Ej Periscope
artefacts.text: Infantry only. The hero gains the Leaper special rule.

artefacts.name: Sir Jesse's Boots of Striding
artefacts.text: Once per game, this unit gains both the Pathfinder and Strider special rules until the end of the Turn.

artefacts.name: Crown of the Wizard King
artefacts.text: The hero gains an additional 6" range on all of its spells that target friendly units.

artefacts.name: Mead of Madness
artefacts.text: The unit gains the Wild Charge (+1) special rule.

artefacts.name: Brew of Haste
artefacts.text: This unit increases its Speed stat by +1.

artefacts.name: Inspiring Talisman
artefacts.text: The hero gains the Inspiring special rule.

artefacts.name: Hammer of Measured Force
artefacts.text: In Combat, this unit will always damage the enemy on a 4+ regardless of any other modifiers.

artefacts.name: Brew of Strength
artefacts.text: The unit gains the Crushing Strength (+1) special rule.

artefacts.name: Brew of Sharpness
artefacts.text: The unit has a +1 to hit modifier with Combat attacks.
